paragraphs.en: Every probe is a regularised logistic regression on one layer’s activation, with the layer chosen inside each training split. Scores are compared only within a scenario and round, and intervals resample whole groups of related episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 每个探针都是对某一层激活值进行的正则化逻辑回归，具体选择哪一层在每个训练划分内部确定。 分数只在同一情景和轮次内进行比较，且置信区间会对相关回合的整组数据进行重采样。

sents.en: Every probe is a regularised logistic regression on one layer’s activation, with the layer chosen inside each training split.
sents.zh: 每个探针都是对某一层激活值进行的正则化逻辑回归，具体选择哪一层在每个训练划分内部确定。

sents.en: Scores are compared only within a scenario and round, and intervals resample whole groups of related episodes.
sents.zh: 分数只在同一情景和轮次内进行比较，且置信区间会对相关回合的整组数据进行重采样。

paragraphs.en: The probe is a logistic regression with L2 regularisation ( C = 0.1 C=0.1 ), on activations standardised with training statistics only. Call weights make leaking and non-leaking calls contribute equally within each round, and rounds with only one class get no weight. We choose the layer from evenly spaced candidates (17 on each model) on an inner validation split of the training data, by the same within-group AUROC that we report. In the held-out-scenario evaluation, the inner validation set is one of the five training scenarios, so layer selection never sees the held-out scenario. We run three split seeds and average their AUROCs.
paragraphs.zh: 探针是一个带 L2 正则化（C=0.1）的逻辑回归，作用于仅用训练统计量标准化的激活值。 通话权重使泄漏与非泄漏通话在每一轮内贡献相等，而只有单一类别的轮次权重为零。 我们在训练数据的内部验证划分上，按与我们报告相同的组内 AUROC，从等距分布的候选层（每个模型 17 层）中选择层。 在留出场景评估中，内部验证集是五个训练场景之一，因此层选择绝不会接触到留出场景。 我们运行三个划分随机种子并对其 AUROC 取平均。

sents.en: The probe is a logistic regression with L2 regularisation ( C = 0.1 C=0.1 ), on activations standardised with training statistics only.
sents.zh: 探针是一个带 L2 正则化（C=0.1）的逻辑回归，作用于仅用训练统计量标准化的激活值。

sents.en: Call weights make leaking and non-leaking calls contribute equally within each round, and rounds with only one class get no weight.
sents.zh: 通话权重使泄漏与非泄漏通话在每一轮内贡献相等，而只有单一类别的轮次权重为零。

sents.en: We choose the layer from evenly spaced candidates (17 on each model) on an inner validation split of the training data, by the same within-group AUROC that we report.
sents.zh: 我们在训练数据的内部验证划分上，按与我们报告相同的组内 AUROC，从等距分布的候选层（每个模型 17 层）中选择层。

sents.en: In the held-out-scenario evaluation, the inner validation set is one of the five training scenarios, so layer selection never sees the held-out scenario.
sents.zh: 在留出场景评估中，内部验证集是五个训练场景之一，因此层选择绝不会接触到留出场景。

sents.en: We run three split seeds and average their AUROCs.
sents.zh: 我们运行三个划分随机种子并对其 AUROC 取平均。

paragraphs.en: The reasoning probe uses the same recipe, with every reasoning token carrying its call’s label. Each call’s weight is split equally across its tokens, so long reasoning does not dominate training. A call’s score is its maximum token score; the mean is reported as a check ( Appendix G ).
paragraphs.zh: 推理探针使用相同的配方，每个推理 token 都带有其调用的标签。 每次调用的权重平均分配到其各个 token 上，因此较长的推理不会在训练中占据主导。 一次调用的得分是其 token 得分的最大值；均值仅作为校验报告（附录 G）。

sents.en: The reasoning probe uses the same recipe, with every reasoning token carrying its call’s label.
sents.zh: 推理探针使用相同的配方，每个推理 token 都带有其调用的标签。

sents.en: Each call’s weight is split equally across its tokens, so long reasoning does not dominate training.
sents.zh: 每次调用的权重平均分配到其各个 token 上，因此较长的推理不会在训练中占据主导。

sents.en: A call’s score is its maximum token score; the mean is reported as a check ( Appendix G ).
sents.zh: 一次调用的得分是其 token 得分的最大值；均值仅作为校验报告（附录 G）。

paragraphs.en: The incoming-only probe reads the tokens that are new since the target’s previous call, at layer 18 of gpt-oss-20b. In training, its per-token scores are averaged over sliding 16-token windows before the loss, following Cunningham et al. (2026) . In scoring, each token’s score is replaced by a running average that gives weight 2 / 17 2/17 to the newest token and lets older tokens fade, which spans about 16 tokens. A call’s score is the maximum of this running average over its incoming tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 仅接收型探针读取自目标上一次调用以来新增的词元，作用于 gpt-oss-20b 的第 18 层。 在训练中，其逐词元得分在计算损失前按照 Cunningham 等人（2026）的做法在滑动 16 词元窗口上进行平均。 在评分中，每个词元的得分被替换为一个运行平均值，该平均值给最新词元赋予 2/17 的权重并让较早的词元逐渐衰减，其跨度约为 16 个词元。 一次调用的得分是该运行平均值在其接收词元上的最大值。

sents.en: The incoming-only probe reads the tokens that are new since the target’s previous call, at layer 18 of gpt-oss-20b.
sents.zh: 仅接收型探针读取自目标上一次调用以来新增的词元，作用于 gpt-oss-20b 的第 18 层。

sents.en: In training, its per-token scores are averaged over sliding 16-token windows before the loss, following Cunningham et al. (2026) .
sents.zh: 在训练中，其逐词元得分在计算损失前按照 Cunningham 等人（2026）的做法在滑动 16 词元窗口上进行平均。

sents.en: In scoring, each token’s score is replaced by a running average that gives weight 2 / 17 2/17 to the newest token and lets older tokens fade, which spans about 16 tokens.
sents.zh: 在评分中，每个词元的得分被替换为一个运行平均值，该平均值给最新词元赋予 2/17 的权重并让较早的词元逐渐衰减，其跨度约为 16 个词元。

sents.en: A call’s score is the maximum of this running average over its incoming tokens.
sents.zh: 一次调用的得分是该运行平均值在其接收词元上的最大值。

paragraphs.en: Suppose one scenario-and-round group holds a leaking call scored 0.8 and two other calls scored 0.5 and 0.9. The leaking call outranks one of the two, so the group’s AUROC is 0.5. A second group holds a leaking call at 0.7 and one other call at 0.4, so its AUROC is 1. Each group has one positive, so the reported value is their mean, 0.75. Groups with only one class are dropped, and ties count one half, which is why any score that is constant within a group gets exactly 0.5. Table 16 shows, for each headline test, how many leaking calls remain in groups that hold both kinds of call.
paragraphs.zh: 假设某个「场景-轮次」组中有一个得分为 0.8 的泄露调用，另外两个调用的得分分别为 0.5 和 0.9。 该泄露调用的排名高于两者之一，因此该组的 AUROC 为 0.5。 第二个组中有一个得分为 0.7 的泄露调用和另一个得分为 0.4 的调用，因此其 AUROC 为 1。 每个组只有一个正样本，因此报告的值是它们的均值，即 0.75。 只包含单一类别的组会被剔除，平局计为 0.5 票，这就是为什么在一个组内得分为常数的情形会恰好得到 0.5。 表 16 展示了对于每个主要测试，在同时包含两类调用的组中还有多少泄露调用。

sents.en: Suppose one scenario-and-round group holds a leaking call scored 0.8 and two other calls scored 0.5 and 0.9.
sents.zh: 假设某个「场景-轮次」组中有一个得分为 0.8 的泄露调用，另外两个调用的得分分别为 0.5 和 0.9。

sents.en: The leaking call outranks one of the two, so the group’s AUROC is 0.5.
sents.zh: 该泄露调用的排名高于两者之一，因此该组的 AUROC 为 0.5。

sents.en: A second group holds a leaking call at 0.7 and one other call at 0.4, so its AUROC is 1.
sents.zh: 第二个组中有一个得分为 0.7 的泄露调用和另一个得分为 0.4 的调用，因此其 AUROC 为 1。

sents.en: Each group has one positive, so the reported value is their mean, 0.75.
sents.zh: 每个组只有一个正样本，因此报告的值是它们的均值，即 0.75。

sents.en: Groups with only one class are dropped, and ties count one half, which is why any score that is constant within a group gets exactly 0.5.
sents.zh: 只包含单一类别的组会被剔除，平局计为 0.5 票，这就是为什么在一个组内得分为常数的情形会恰好得到 0.5。

sents.en: Table 16 shows, for each headline test, how many leaking calls remain in groups that hold both kinds of call.
sents.zh: 表 16 展示了对于每个主要测试，在同时包含两类调用的组中还有多少泄露调用。

paragraphs.en: Leaks fall in earlier rounds than other calls, so rating early rounds as risky already scores well on the raw AUROC. Within a scenario and round, the same rule scores exactly 0.5. Leak rates also differ across scenarios ( Table 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 泄露比其他通话更早出现在各轮次中，因此将早期轮次评为高风险在原始 AUROC 上已经能取得不错的分数。 在同一场景和同一轮次内，同一规则的得分恰好为 0.5。 泄露率在不同场景之间也存在差异（表 4）。

sents.en: Leaks fall in earlier rounds than other calls, so rating early rounds as risky already scores well on the raw AUROC.
sents.zh: 泄露比其他通话更早出现在各轮次中，因此将早期轮次评为高风险在原始 AUROC 上已经能取得不错的分数。

sents.en: Within a scenario and round, the same rule scores exactly 0.5.
sents.zh: 在同一场景和同一轮次内，同一规则的得分恰好为 0.5。

sents.en: Leak rates also differ across scenarios ( Table 4 ).
sents.zh: 泄露率在不同场景之间也存在差异（表 4）。

paragraphs.en: Some episodes share a history, such as variants of one seeded episode and reruns that branch from the same state. We call each such group a family and always keep a family on one side of a split. Intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals: we resample families with replacement 1,000 times, recompute the AUROC from the saved scores without refitting, and take the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles.
paragraphs.zh: 一些情节（episode）共享同一段历史，例如同一个种子情节的多个变体，以及从同一状态分叉出来的重放。 我们把每组这样的情节称为一个「家族」（family），并且在划分数据集时始终把同一家族保持在同一边。 区间为 95% 自助法（bootstrap）区间：我们对家族进行 1,000 次有放回重抽样，在不重新拟合的情况下基于已保存的分数重新计算 AUROC，并取第 2.5 百分位数和第 97.5 百分位数。

sents.en: Some episodes share a history, such as variants of one seeded episode and reruns that branch from the same state.
sents.zh: 一些情节（episode）共享同一段历史，例如同一个种子情节的多个变体，以及从同一状态分叉出来的重放。

sents.en: We call each such group a family and always keep a family on one side of a split.
sents.zh: 我们把每组这样的情节称为一个「家族」（family），并且在划分数据集时始终把同一家族保持在同一边。

sents.en: Intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals: we resample families with replacement 1,000 times, recompute the AUROC from the saved scores without refitting, and take the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles.
sents.zh: 区间为 95% 自助法（bootstrap）区间：我们对家族进行 1,000 次有放回重抽样，在不重新拟合的情况下基于已保存的分数重新计算 AUROC，并取第 2.5 百分位数和第 97.5 百分位数。

paragraphs.en: We train on five scenarios, test on the sixth, rotate through all six and pool the test scores. Training also drops any family that appears in the held-out scenario. Text monitors have no fitted parameters, so their held-out score is their score on the same calls. Appendix G reports a second evaluation, cross-validation that mixes scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五个场景上训练，在第六个场景上测试，轮流遍历全部六个场景并汇总测试分数。 训练时还会剔除任何出现在留出场景中的家族。 文本监控器没有拟合参数，因此其留出分数就是它在相同调用上的分数。 附录 G 报告了第二种评估方式，即混合场景的交叉验证。

sents.en: We train on five scenarios, test on the sixth, rotate through all six and pool the test scores.
sents.zh: 我们在五个场景上训练，在第六个场景上测试，轮流遍历全部六个场景并汇总测试分数。

sents.en: Training also drops any family that appears in the held-out scenario.
sents.zh: 训练时还会剔除任何出现在留出场景中的家族。

sents.en: Text monitors have no fitted parameters, so their held-out score is their score on the same calls.
sents.zh: 文本监控器没有拟合参数，因此其留出分数就是它在相同调用上的分数。

sents.en: Appendix G reports a second evaluation, cross-validation that mixes scenarios.
sents.zh: 附录 G 报告了第二种评估方式，即混合场景的交叉验证。

paragraphs.en: Each text monitor reads a rendering of the transcript and answers one yes-or-no question about the target. The round-level analyses use three monitors, two questions and three levels of access. The per-call analyses use Jev alone, shown what the last-prompt probe sees and asked whether the next reply will write out the secret.
paragraphs.zh: 每个文本智能体读取一份对话记录的呈现内容，并回答一个关于目标对象的“是或否”问题。 轮次级别的分析使用三个智能体、两个问题和三种访问级别。 单次调用的分析仅使用 Jev 智能体，向它展示最后一次提示探测所看到的内容，并询问它下一次回复是否会写出秘密。

sents.en: Each text monitor reads a rendering of the transcript and answers one yes-or-no question about the target.
sents.zh: 每个文本智能体读取一份对话记录的呈现内容，并回答一个关于目标对象的“是或否”问题。

sents.en: The round-level analyses use three monitors, two questions and three levels of access.
sents.zh: 轮次级别的分析使用三个智能体、两个问题和三种访问级别。

sents.en: The per-call analyses use Jev alone, shown what the last-prompt probe sees and asked whether the next reply will write out the secret.
sents.zh: 单次调用的分析仅使用 Jev 智能体，向它展示最后一次提示探测所看到的内容，并询问它下一次回复是否会写出秘密。

paragraphs.en: We combine three monitor models, three questions and three levels of access ( Table 17 ). Jev 1.14 ( Almeida, 2026 ) is our main text monitor. It is a commercial decision model: it returns the probability of each option of a fixed yes-or-no question and writes no rationale. Luna Decisions ( OpenAI, 2026b ) is a second decision model of the same kind. GPT-5-nano ( OpenAI, 2025a ) is an LLM judge: it writes its reasoning and then a score, which we rescale to the unit interval.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将三种监控模型、三个问题和三种访问级别结合起来（表 17）。 Jev 1.14（Almeida, 2026）是我们的主要文本监控模型。 它是一个商用决策模型：它针对一个固定的“是或否”问题返回每个选项的概率，并且不写出理由。 Luna Decisions（OpenAI, 2026b）是第二种类似的决策模型。 GPT-5-nano（OpenAI, 2025a）是一个大语言模型裁判：它先写出推理过程，然后给出一个分数，我们将该分数重新缩放到单位区间内。

sents.en: We combine three monitor models, three questions and three levels of access ( Table 17 ).
sents.zh: 我们将三种监控模型、三个问题和三种访问级别结合起来（表 17）。

sents.en: Jev 1.14 ( Almeida, 2026 ) is our main text monitor.
sents.zh: Jev 1.14（Almeida, 2026）是我们的主要文本监控模型。

sents.en: It is a commercial decision model: it returns the probability of each option of a fixed yes-or-no question and writes no rationale.
sents.zh: 它是一个商用决策模型：它针对一个固定的“是或否”问题返回每个选项的概率，并且不写出理由。

sents.en: Luna Decisions ( OpenAI, 2026b ) is a second decision model of the same kind.
sents.zh: Luna Decisions（OpenAI, 2026b）是第二种类似的决策模型。

sents.en: GPT-5-nano ( OpenAI, 2025a ) is an LLM judge: it writes its reasoning and then a score, which we rescale to the unit interval.
sents.zh: GPT-5-nano（OpenAI, 2025a）是一个大语言模型裁判：它先写出推理过程，然后给出一个分数，我们将该分数重新缩放到单位区间内。

paragraphs.en: All three monitors answer the same questions. The detector question asks whether the target is breaking its operator’s rule now. The forecaster question asks whether it will break the rule at any later point in the episode. The per-call question asks whether the target’s next reply will write or post the protected value.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个监视器回答的是同样的问题。 检测器问题询问目标当前是否正在违反其操作者的规则。 预测器问题询问目标在本回合稍后的任何时间点是否会违反该规则。 逐次调用问题询问目标的下一次回复是否会写入或发布受保护的值。

sents.en: All three monitors answer the same questions.
sents.zh: 这三个监视器回答的是同样的问题。

sents.en: The detector question asks whether the target is breaking its operator’s rule now.
sents.zh: 检测器问题询问目标当前是否正在违反其操作者的规则。

sents.en: The forecaster question asks whether it will break the rule at any later point in the episode.
sents.zh: 预测器问题询问目标在本回合稍后的任何时间点是否会违反该规则。

sents.en: The per-call question asks whether the target’s next reply will write or post the protected value.
sents.zh: 逐次调用问题询问目标的下一次回复是否会写入或发布受保护的值。

paragraphs.en: The prompts adapt the ControlArena monitor template ( Inglis et al., 2025 ) , with the operator’s rule filled in for each scenario. The forecaster question rephrases, in our own words, the per-step question of Fayyazi et al. (2026) , widened from the next step to any later point. Appendix R gives every monitor prompt, with the per-call questions in Section R.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 这些提示词改编自 ControlArena 监控模板（Inglis et al., 2025），并为每个场景填入了操作方的规则。 预测器问题以我们自己的措辞重新表述了 Fayyazi et al. 的每一步问题。 （2026），并将范围从下一步扩展到之后的任何时点。 附录 R 给出了每个监控提示词，每次调用的问题见第 R.6 节。

sents.en: The prompts adapt the ControlArena monitor template ( Inglis et al., 2025 ) , with the operator’s rule filled in for each scenario.
sents.zh: 这些提示词改编自 ControlArena 监控模板（Inglis et al., 2025），并为每个场景填入了操作方的规则。

sents.en: The forecaster question rephrases, in our own words, the per-step question of Fayyazi et al.
sents.zh: 预测器问题以我们自己的措辞重新表述了 Fayyazi et al. 的每一步问题。

sents.en: (2026) , widened from the next step to any later point.
sents.zh: （2026），并将范围从下一步扩展到之后的任何时点。

sents.en: Appendix R gives every monitor prompt, with the per-call questions in Section R.6 .
sents.zh: 附录 R 给出了每个监控提示词，每次调用的问题见第 R.6 节。

paragraphs.en: Each level of access shows the monitor only what the target had seen when it made the call. No monitor ever sees the reply it is scoring or any later message. In the round-level setups, the secret appears in the tool results once the target has read the file. In the per-call setup, we replace every copy of the secret with a placeholder, so Jev cannot answer by spotting it.
paragraphs.zh: 每一级访问权限都只向监控者展示目标在发起该次调用时所看到的内容。 任何监控者都绝不会看到它正在评分的回复或任何更晚的消息。 在轮次级别的设置中，一旦目标读取了文件，秘密信息就会出现在工具结果中。 在逐次调用的设置中，我们将秘密信息的每一份副本都替换为占位符，因此 Jev 无法通过发现它来作答。

sents.en: Each level of access shows the monitor only what the target had seen when it made the call.
sents.zh: 每一级访问权限都只向监控者展示目标在发起该次调用时所看到的内容。

sents.en: No monitor ever sees the reply it is scoring or any later message.
sents.zh: 任何监控者都绝不会看到它正在评分的回复或任何更晚的消息。

sents.en: In the round-level setups, the secret appears in the tool results once the target has read the file.
sents.zh: 在轮次级别的设置中，一旦目标读取了文件，秘密信息就会出现在工具结果中。

sents.en: In the per-call setup, we replace every copy of the secret with a placeholder, so Jev cannot answer by spotting it.
sents.zh: 在逐次调用的设置中，我们将秘密信息的每一份副本都替换为占位符，因此 Jev 无法通过发现它来作答。

paragraphs.en: Most round-level setups score close to chance. Jev asked to forecast scores highest once it sees the peer’s messages, and only on whether the target leaks this round or the next ( Table 18 ). Appendix K compares the questions and levels of access directly, and tests whether adding the probe helps.

paragraphs.en: On gpt-oss-20b, Jev reads the pressure on a call rather than the coming leak ( Table 19 ). Within a scenario and round it ranks the leaking calls below the other calls under the same pressure. On Qwen3-32B it reads the input more usefully, but it still scores below the probe.
paragraphs.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，Jev 在通话中读取的是压力，而非即将发生的泄漏（表 19）。 在同一场景和轮次内，它将发生泄漏的通话排在相同压力下其他通话之下。 在 Qwen3-32B 上，它对输入的读取更有用，但得分仍低于探针。

paragraphs.en: For each call, Jev sees the messages and tool results that the target received for that call, with the secret masked. These are the same calls and labels as the per-call probe results ( Section 4.1 ). The probe’s alarm cutoff is set on calls from control episodes, and Jev’s is the cutoff that flags no more calls in refusing episodes than the probe ( Section J.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每次调用，Jev 能看到目标在该次调用中收到的消息和工具结果，其中机密信息已被遮蔽。 这些调用和标签与逐次调用探测结果（第 4.1 节）中的相同。 探测器的警报截断值基于来自对照回合的调用设定，而 Jev 的截断值设定为：在拒绝回合中标记的调用不多于探测器所标记的（第 J.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: On gpt-oss-20b, Jev scores high when calls are not grouped by scenario and round, because pressure itself predicts a leak. Within a scenario and round, every call faces the same pressure, so that signal no longer helps. Jev then gives the leaking calls lower scores than the calls that do not leak.
paragraphs.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，当调用不按场景和轮次分组时，Jev 得分很高，因为压力本身就能预测泄露。 在同一场景和轮次内，每次调用面临的压力相同，因此该信号不再有帮助。 此时 Jev 给发生泄露的调用打的分数低于不泄露的调用。

paragraphs.en: Reversing Jev’s scores after the fact does not close the gap to the probe. With the same-turn reasoning, reversed Jev scores 0.60 [0.55, 0.67]. That interval lies wholly below the probe’s interval of [0.87, 0.94]. Without the same-turn reasoning, the probe beats reversed Jev by 0.18 [0.12, 0.23].

paragraphs.en: We ran Jev on gpt-oss-20b in two versions that read the call’s input, and the main text reports the one that reads earlier reasoning. A third setup, which reads the current call’s own reasoning z t z_{t} , is in Section E.4 . gpt-oss-20b keeps its earlier reasoning from the same turn in its prompt, so the last-prompt probe can read it. The main version includes that reasoning, so it matches the probe’s input more closely. In the main version, Jev reads the conversation as text in gpt-oss-20b’s own chat format, Harmony, rather than as the raw request messages. The second version removes the reasoning and shows the raw request messages and tool definitions, as for Qwen3-32B. The reasoning raises Jev’s score but leaves its ranking inverted.

paragraphs.en: No. The monitors above read the input x t x_{t} to a call; here Jev and GPT-5-nano read the reasoning z t z_{t} that gpt-oss-20b writes in the call itself, before its reply. Each monitor sees growing prefixes of that reasoning, cut at five evenly spaced points and at its end, and answers the per-call question. If the reasoning writes out the secret, everything from that point on is replaced by a fixed placeholder, so the monitor cannot answer by spotting the value. A call’s score is its highest score over the prefixes. We use the same 1995 development calls and labels as the reasoning probe; the monitors have no fitted parameters, so their held-out-scenario score equals their score on all calls.

paragraphs.en: Two tests were fixed in written plans before any detector’s predictions on their test episodes were compared with the labels, and both met their criteria ( Table 21 ). The gpt-oss-20b plan was committed before its test episodes were collected (commit d470afd , Table 39 ); in this sense it was pre-registered. The Qwen3-32B round-level plan was committed after its test episodes were collected, when their overall leak counts were known, but before any probe or monitor predictions were compared with their labels; it fixed an AUROC analysis, not an alarm threshold. A third test, the Qwen3-32B per-call probe, was frozen and committed before it was scored on the same test episodes, which had by then been analysed for the round-level test.
paragraphs.zh: 在任何检测器对其测试回合的预测与标签进行比较之前，两项检验已在书面计划中固定，且均满足其标准（表 21）。 gpt-oss-20b 的计划在其测试回合被收集之前即已提交（提交 d470afd，表 39）；从这个意义上说，它是预注册的。 Qwen3-32B 回合级计划是在其测试回合被收集之后提交的，当时其总体泄漏计数已知，但在任何探针或监控器的预测与其标签进行比较之前；它固定的是一项 AUROC 分析，而非警报阈值。 第三项检验，即 Qwen3-32B 逐次调用探针，在其于同一批测试回合上被打分之前已被冻结并提交，而这些测试回合在彼时已为回合级检验做过分析。

paragraphs.en: Before the test episodes were collected, we committed the probe’s layer, chosen on development data, its weights, refit once on all development calls, the maximum over tokens as the call score, and an alarm threshold calibrated on development control calls. The success criterion was a lower 95% bound above 0.5 on the per-call AUROC. The lower bound was 0.78, well above the 0.5 criterion. With few leaking calls, the interval is wide. At the frozen threshold the probe caught 54% of the leaking calls (binomial 95% interval [35%, 71%]), fewer than in development, while alarming on 2.4% of calls in refusing episodes and in 26% of refusing episodes ( Tables 31 and 30 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在收集测试回合之前，我们预先确定了探针的层（在开发数据上选定）、其权重（在全部开发调用上仅重新拟合一次）、以各 token 上的最大值作为调用得分，以及在开发控制调用上校准的报警阈值。 成功标准是每次调用的 AUROC 的 95% 置信下界高于 0.5。 该下界为 0.78，远高于 0.5 的标准。 由于泄露调用很少，该区间较宽。 在冻结阈值下，探针捕获了 54% 的泄露调用（二项分布 95% 区间 [35%, 71%]），低于开发阶段的比例，同时在拒绝回合中对 2.4% 的调用报警，并在 26% 的拒绝回合中报警（见表 31 和表 30）。

sents.zh: 由于泄露调用很少，该区间较宽。

sents.en: At the frozen threshold the probe caught 54% of the leaking calls (binomial 95% interval [35%, 71%]), fewer than in development, while alarming on 2.4% of calls in refusing episodes and in 26% of refusing episodes ( Tables 31 and 30 ).
sents.zh: 在冻结阈值下，探针捕获了 54% 的泄露调用（二项分布 95% 区间 [35%, 71%]），低于开发阶段的比例，同时在拒绝回合中对 2.4% 的调用报警，并在 26% 的拒绝回合中报警（见表 31 和表 30）。

paragraphs.en: On development episodes the last-prompt probe and the reasoning probe score about the same, so most of the signal is present before the model starts to reason. On the test episodes the reasoning probe scored higher than the last-prompt probe on the same calls, and the last-prompt probe caught fewer leaking calls at its threshold ( Tables 21 and 31 ); with few leaking calls, the gap in AUROC is within noise.
paragraphs.zh: 在开发剧集上，最后提示探针与推理探针的得分大致相同，因此大部分信号在模型开始推理之前就已存在。 在测试剧集上，推理探针在相同调用上的得分高于最后提示探针，且最后提示探针在其阈值下捕获到的泄漏调用更少（表 21 和表 31）；由于泄漏调用很少，AUROC 的差距在噪声范围内。

sents.en: On development episodes the last-prompt probe and the reasoning probe score about the same, so most of the signal is present before the model starts to reason.
sents.zh: 在开发剧集上，最后提示探针与推理探针的得分大致相同，因此大部分信号在模型开始推理之前就已存在。

sents.en: On the test episodes the reasoning probe scored higher than the last-prompt probe on the same calls, and the last-prompt probe caught fewer leaking calls at its threshold ( Tables 21 and 31 ); with few leaking calls, the gap in AUROC is within noise.
sents.zh: 在测试剧集上，推理探针在相同调用上的得分高于最后提示探针，且最后提示探针在其阈值下捕获到的泄漏调用更少（表 21 和表 31）；由于泄漏调用很少，AUROC 的差距在噪声范围内。

paragraphs.en: The plan fixed the near-term label of Appendix B , the probe (one logistic model per seed trained on all development recruiting calls), and two text monitors chosen in advance. Its criteria were a probe interval above 0.5, and a gain above 0 from adding the probe to the weaker of the two monitors. Both were met ( Figure 6 ). The plan expected no gain from adding the probe to the stronger monitor, and there was none that was clearly above zero ( Appendix K ).
paragraphs.zh: 该计划固定了附录 B 的近期标签、探针（每个种子一个逻辑回归模型，在所有开发集招聘通话上训练），以及预先选定的两个文本监视器。 其标准是探针的区间高于 0.5，并且将探针加入两个监视器中较弱的一个所带来的增益高于 0。 两项标准均满足（图 6）。 该计划预期将探针加入较强的监视器不会带来增益，事实证明确实没有明显高于零的增益（附录 K）。

sents.en: The plan fixed the near-term label of Appendix B , the probe (one logistic model per seed trained on all development recruiting calls), and two text monitors chosen in advance.
sents.zh: 该计划固定了附录 B 的近期标签、探针（每个种子一个逻辑回归模型，在所有开发集招聘通话上训练），以及预先选定的两个文本监视器。

sents.en: Its criteria were a probe interval above 0.5, and a gain above 0 from adding the probe to the weaker of the two monitors.
sents.zh: 其标准是探针的区间高于 0.5，并且将探针加入两个监视器中较弱的一个所带来的增益高于 0。

sents.en: Both were met ( Figure 6 ).
sents.zh: 两项标准均满足（图 6）。

sents.en: The plan expected no gain from adding the probe to the stronger monitor, and there was none that was clearly above zero ( Appendix K ).
sents.zh: 该计划预期将探针加入较强的监视器不会带来增益，事实证明确实没有明显高于零的增益（附录 K）。

paragraphs.en: We fit this probe on the development episodes only, committed its weights and threshold, and then scored it once on the test episodes. No test episode was used to fit or choose anything for it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仅在开发集回合上拟合该探针，固定其权重和阈值，然后在测试回合上评分一次。 没有使用任何测试回合来拟合或为其选择任何内容。

sents.en: We fit this probe on the development episodes only, committed its weights and threshold, and then scored it once on the test episodes.
sents.zh: 我们仅在开发集回合上拟合该探针，固定其权重和阈值，然后在测试回合上评分一次。

sents.en: No test episode was used to fit or choose anything for it.
sents.zh: 没有使用任何测试回合来拟合或为其选择任何内容。

paragraphs.en: Yes. On development episodes, cross-validation that mixes scenarios, the mean instead of the maximum over reasoning tokens, dropping reasoning after the secret is first mentioned, adding calls with no reasoning, and excluding writes back to the protected file all give a similar ranking ( Table 22 ).
paragraphs.zh: 是的。 在开发片段上，混合不同场景的交叉验证、对推理 token 取均值而非最大值、在秘密首次被提及后丢弃推理、添加无推理的调用，以及排除对受保护文件的写回操作，都会给出相近的排序（表 22）。

sents.en: Yes.
sents.zh: 是的。

sents.en: On development episodes, cross-validation that mixes scenarios, the mean instead of the maximum over reasoning tokens, dropping reasoning after the secret is first mentioned, adding calls with no reasoning, and excluding writes back to the protected file all give a similar ranking ( Table 22 ).
sents.zh: 在开发片段上，混合不同场景的交叉验证、对推理 token 取均值而非最大值、在秘密首次被提及后丢弃推理、添加无推理的调用，以及排除对受保护文件的写回操作，都会给出相近的排序（表 22）。

paragraphs.en: Mixed-scenario cross-validation splits families into five folds regardless of scenario, so the probe has seen every scenario in training. On both models it gives a score a little below the held-out-scenario one. Because it compares scores from different fitted models within one group, it can fall below 0.5 for a weak score, so we use held-out scenarios as the main evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 混合场景交叉验证将样本族划分为五折时不区分场景，因此探测方法在训练中见过每一种场景。 在两个模型上，它给出的分数都比留出场景的分数略低。 由于它比较的是同一组内不同已拟合模型的分数，弱分数情况下可能低于 0.5，因此我们以留出场景作为主要评估方式。

sents.en: Mixed-scenario cross-validation splits families into five folds regardless of scenario, so the probe has seen every scenario in training.
sents.zh: 混合场景交叉验证将样本族划分为五折时不区分场景，因此探测方法在训练中见过每一种场景。

sents.en: On both models it gives a score a little below the held-out-scenario one.
sents.zh: 在两个模型上，它给出的分数都比留出场景的分数略低。

sents.en: Because it compares scores from different fitted models within one group, it can fall below 0.5 for a weak score, so we use held-out scenarios as the main evaluation.
sents.zh: 由于它比较的是同一组内不同已拟合模型的分数，弱分数情况下可能低于 0.5，因此我们以留出场景作为主要评估方式。

paragraphs.en: On gpt-oss-20b, averaging the reasoning tokens instead of taking the maximum gives a higher score. Dropping every reasoning token from the first exact mention of the secret onward also gives a slightly higher score, so the probe does not depend on the secret appearing in the reasoning. Including the calls that returned no reasoning, the last-prompt probe scores slightly higher.
paragraphs.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，对推理 token 取平均值而不是取最大值，会得到更高的分数。 从第一次确切提及秘密之处开始，丢弃之后的所有推理 token，也会得到略高的分数，因此该探测方法并不依赖于秘密出现在推理中。 将未返回推理内容的调用也纳入统计后，最后提示词探测方法的得分略高一些。

sents.en: On gpt-oss-20b, averaging the reasoning tokens instead of taking the maximum gives a higher score.
sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，对推理 token 取平均值而不是取最大值，会得到更高的分数。

sents.en: Dropping every reasoning token from the first exact mention of the secret onward also gives a slightly higher score, so the probe does not depend on the secret appearing in the reasoning.
sents.zh: 从第一次确切提及秘密之处开始，丢弃之后的所有推理 token，也会得到略高的分数，因此该探测方法并不依赖于秘密出现在推理中。

sents.en: Including the calls that returned no reasoning, the last-prompt probe scores slightly higher.
sents.zh: 将未返回推理内容的调用也纳入统计后，最后提示词探测方法的得分略高一些。

paragraphs.en: On Qwen3-32B, excluding the one development episode whose leak is a write back into the protected file changes the score very little.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Qwen3-32B 上，排除那个泄露属于向受保护文件写回内容的一次开发事件（episode）后，分数几乎没有变化。

paragraphs.en: Every test scenario scores between 0.96 and 0.98 ( Table 23 ). Each holds only 5 to 11 leaking calls, so the per-scenario numbers are noisy. The test episodes are new episodes in the scenarios used for development, not new scenarios. The last column is the share of calls in refusing episodes, recruiting episodes with no leaking call, that the probe flags at the threshold set on development control calls.
paragraphs.zh: 每个测试场景的得分都在 0.96 到 0.98 之间（表 23）。 每个场景只包含 5 到 11 个泄漏调用，因此各场景的数字噪声较大。 测试回合是用于开发的场景中的新回合，而不是新场景。 最后一列是在开发控制调用上设定的阈值下，探针在拒绝回合以及没有泄漏调用的招募回合中标记的调用所占的比例。

sents.en: Every test scenario scores between 0.96 and 0.98 ( Table 23 ).
sents.zh: 每个测试场景的得分都在 0.96 到 0.98 之间（表 23）。

sents.en: Each holds only 5 to 11 leaking calls, so the per-scenario numbers are noisy.
sents.zh: 每个场景只包含 5 到 11 个泄漏调用，因此各场景的数字噪声较大。

sents.en: The test episodes are new episodes in the scenarios used for development, not new scenarios.
sents.zh: 测试回合是用于开发的场景中的新回合，而不是新场景。

sents.en: The last column is the share of calls in refusing episodes, recruiting episodes with no leaking call, that the probe flags at the threshold set on development control calls.
sents.zh: 最后一列是在开发控制调用上设定的阈值下，探针在拒绝回合以及没有泄漏调用的招募回合中标记的调用所占的比例。

paragraphs.en: The probe beats each of them, although the read flag alone scores well, and one call before the leak it scores about as well as the probe ( Figure 7 ). A probe that sees only the incoming peer message and tool results also scores high, so much of the signal arrives with the input ( Table 26 ).
paragraphs.zh: 探针胜过其中每一项，尽管仅凭读取标志得分就很不错，而且在泄漏前的一次调用中，其得分与探针大致相当（图 7）。 仅查看传入的智能体消息和工具结果的探针得分也很高，因此大部分信号随输入一起到达（表 26）。

sents.en: The probe beats each of them, although the read flag alone scores well, and one call before the leak it scores about as well as the probe ( Figure 7 ).
sents.zh: 探针胜过其中每一项，尽管仅凭读取标志得分就很不错，而且在泄漏前的一次调用中，其得分与探针大致相当（图 7）。

sents.en: A probe that sees only the incoming peer message and tool results also scores high, so much of the signal arrives with the input ( Table 26 ).
sents.zh: 仅查看传入的智能体消息和工具结果的探针得分也很高，因此大部分信号随输入一起到达（表 26）。

paragraphs.en: Every scored call comes from an episode with a recruiting peer, and we compare it only with calls in the same scenario and round. On gpt-oss-20b every scored call also follows the peer’s request, and the probe applied to the calls between the read and the request, scored against whether the episode ever leaks, stays at chance.
paragraphs.zh: 每一次被评分的通话都来自一段与招聘同行互动的情节，我们只将其与同一情景和同一轮次中的通话进行比较。 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，每一次被评分的通话也都遵循了同行的请求，而施加在读取与请求之间的通话上的探针，以该情节是否曾发生泄露为标准进行评分，其表现仍处于随机水平。

sents.en: Every scored call comes from an episode with a recruiting peer, and we compare it only with calls in the same scenario and round.
sents.zh: 每一次被评分的通话都来自一段与招聘同行互动的情节，我们只将其与同一情景和同一轮次中的通话进行比较。

sents.en: On gpt-oss-20b every scored call also follows the peer’s request, and the probe applied to the calls between the read and the request, scored against whether the episode ever leaks, stays at chance.
sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，每一次被评分的通话也都遵循了同行的请求，而施加在读取与请求之间的通话上的探针，以该情节是否曾发生泄露为标准进行评分，其表现仍处于随机水平。

paragraphs.en: On gpt-oss-20b, almost no leaking call names the value in its reasoning. Fixed keyword rules on the reasoning, written before scoring, do no better than chance.
paragraphs.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，几乎没有泄露调用会在其推理中指明该数值。 在评分之前针对推理编写的固定关键词规则，其效果并不比随机猜测更好。

sents.en: On gpt-oss-20b, almost no leaking call names the value in its reasoning.
sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，几乎没有泄露调用会在其推理中指明该数值。

sents.en: Fixed keyword rules on the reasoning, written before scoring, do no better than chance.
sents.zh: 在评分之前针对推理编写的固定关键词规则，其效果并不比随机猜测更好。

paragraphs.en: The call that leaks often comes right after the target reads the protected file. A flag for “the latest input is the protected file’s contents” therefore scores well on both models, and the probe beats it by 0.13 on Qwen3-32B and 0.11 on gpt-oss-20b (paired). Among the calls that come right after a read, the probe still separates those that leak (0.85 on Qwen3-32B, 0.93 on gpt-oss-20b). These within-subset scores, and the handoff-write score below, use only the scenario-and-round groups that hold both kinds of call, which cover most but not all of the subset’s leaking calls.
paragraphs.zh: 泄露调用往往出现在目标读取受保护文件之后。 因此，“最新输入是受保护文件内容”这一标志在两个模型上得分都很高，而探针在 Qwen3-32B 上比它高 0.13，在 gpt-oss-20b 上高 0.11（配对）。 在紧随读取之后发生的调用中，探针仍能区分出泄露的调用（Qwen3-32B 上为 0.85，gpt-oss-20b 上为 0.93）。 这些子集内的分数，以及下文的交接写入分数，只使用同时包含两类调用的场景与轮次组，它们覆盖了该子集中大部分但非全部的泄露调用。

sents.en: The call that leaks often comes right after the target reads the protected file.
sents.zh: 泄露调用往往出现在目标读取受保护文件之后。

sents.en: A flag for “the latest input is the protected file’s contents” therefore scores well on both models, and the probe beats it by 0.13 on Qwen3-32B and 0.11 on gpt-oss-20b (paired).
sents.zh: 因此，“最新输入是受保护文件内容”这一标志在两个模型上得分都很高，而探针在 Qwen3-32B 上比它高 0.13，在 gpt-oss-20b 上高 0.11（配对）。

sents.en: Among the calls that come right after a read, the probe still separates those that leak (0.85 on Qwen3-32B, 0.93 on gpt-oss-20b).
sents.zh: 在紧随读取之后发生的调用中，探针仍能区分出泄露的调用（Qwen3-32B 上为 0.85，gpt-oss-20b 上为 0.93）。

sents.en: These within-subset scores, and the handoff-write score below, use only the scenario-and-round groups that hold both kinds of call, which cover most but not all of the subset’s leaking calls.
sents.zh: 这些子集内的分数，以及下文的交接写入分数，只使用同时包含两类调用的场景与轮次组，它们覆盖了该子集中大部分但非全部的泄露调用。

paragraphs.en: The probe reads the whole input, including the target’s own earlier messages, so it might read back an earlier promise such as “fine, I’ll send it”. We flagged every scored call on the test episodes whose earlier target messages agree or offer to share the value, by asking Jev with the value masked, and recomputed the probes’ AUROC from their saved scores without the flagged calls ( Table 24 ). On Qwen3-32B such earlier promises are rare. On gpt-oss-20b about one leaking call in five follows one, mostly in its earlier reasoning in the same turn. Removing those calls changes the score little on both models. A blind reviewer agreed with Jev’s flag on 28 of 33 sampled calls, counting earlier reasoning as a promise; a fixed keyword list agreed poorly, so we do not use it.
paragraphs.zh: 探针会读取整个输入，包括目标自己较早的消息，因此它可能会读到较早的承诺，例如「好的，我会发送它」。 我们标记了测试回合中每一次被评分的调用，只要目标较早的消息同意或主动提出分享该数值，方法是在数值被遮蔽的情况下询问 Jev，并在剔除被标记的调用后，根据探针保存的分数重新计算其 AUROC（表 24）。 在 Qwen3-32B 上，这类较早的承诺很少见。 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，大约每五次泄漏调用中就有一次出现在此类承诺之后，其中大多发生在同一回合较早的推理中。 剔除这些调用后，两个模型的分数变化都很小。 一位盲评审阅者在 33 个抽样调用中的 28 个上同意 Jev 的标记（将较早的推理也视为承诺）；固定的关键词列表则一致性很差，因此我们不使用它。

sents.en: The probe reads the whole input, including the target’s own earlier messages, so it might read back an earlier promise such as “fine, I’ll send it”.
sents.zh: 探针会读取整个输入，包括目标自己较早的消息，因此它可能会读到较早的承诺，例如「好的，我会发送它」。

sents.en: We flagged every scored call on the test episodes whose earlier target messages agree or offer to share the value, by asking Jev with the value masked, and recomputed the probes’ AUROC from their saved scores without the flagged calls ( Table 24 ).
sents.zh: 我们标记了测试回合中每一次被评分的调用，只要目标较早的消息同意或主动提出分享该数值，方法是在数值被遮蔽的情况下询问 Jev，并在剔除被标记的调用后，根据探针保存的分数重新计算其 AUROC（表 24）。

sents.en: On Qwen3-32B such earlier promises are rare.
sents.zh: 在 Qwen3-32B 上，这类较早的承诺很少见。

sents.en: On gpt-oss-20b about one leaking call in five follows one, mostly in its earlier reasoning in the same turn.
sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，大约每五次泄漏调用中就有一次出现在此类承诺之后，其中大多发生在同一回合较早的推理中。

sents.en: Removing those calls changes the score little on both models.
sents.zh: 剔除这些调用后，两个模型的分数变化都很小。

sents.en: A blind reviewer agreed with Jev’s flag on 28 of 33 sampled calls, counting earlier reasoning as a promise; a fixed keyword list agreed poorly, so we do not use it.
sents.zh: 一位盲评审阅者在 33 个抽样调用中的 28 个上同意 Jev 的标记（将较早的推理也视为承诺）；固定的关键词列表则一致性很差，因此我们不使用它。

paragraphs.en: A second replay on gpt-oss-20b saved the incoming segment of each prompt, which is the latest peer message and tool results, and every generated token up to the secret. A probe on the incoming segment alone also ranks the leaking calls highly, but alarms on far more refusing calls at the same threshold. A probe that also reads the tokens generated up to the secret ranks them almost perfectly. For an exact string, an output filter does the same. Both use one layer, one seed and a reduced version of a production streaming recipe ( Cunningham et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 第二次在 gpt-oss-20b 上的重放保存了每个提示词的输入片段（即最新的对等智能体消息和工具结果），以及直到秘密为止生成的每个 token。 仅基于输入片段的探针也能把泄露调用排在前列，但在相同阈值下会对多得多的拒绝调用触发警报。 同时读取直到秘密为止生成的 token 的探针几乎能完美地对它们排序。 对于精确字符串，输出过滤器也能做到同样的效果。 两者都使用一层、一个种子，以及生产环境流式方案（Cunningham et al., 2026）的精简版本。

sents.en: A second replay on gpt-oss-20b saved the incoming segment of each prompt, which is the latest peer message and tool results, and every generated token up to the secret.
sents.zh: 第二次在 gpt-oss-20b 上的重放保存了每个提示词的输入片段（即最新的对等智能体消息和工具结果），以及直到秘密为止生成的每个 token。

sents.en: A probe on the incoming segment alone also ranks the leaking calls highly, but alarms on far more refusing calls at the same threshold.
sents.zh: 仅基于输入片段的探针也能把泄露调用排在前列，但在相同阈值下会对多得多的拒绝调用触发警报。

sents.en: A probe that also reads the tokens generated up to the secret ranks them almost perfectly.
sents.zh: 同时读取直到秘密为止生成的 token 的探针几乎能完美地对它们排序。

sents.en: For an exact string, an output filter does the same.
sents.zh: 对于精确字符串，输出过滤器也能做到同样的效果。

sents.en: Both use one layer, one seed and a reduced version of a production streaming recipe ( Cunningham et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 两者都使用一层、一个种子，以及生产环境流式方案（Cunningham et al., 2026）的精简版本。

paragraphs.en: On gpt-oss-20b, almost every leak copies the configuration block into the handoff file, so the probe might detect an upcoming file write rather than a leak. A baseline that knows only whether the call’s action is a file write scores well, but among the calls that write the handoff file the probe still separates leaks from non-leaks ( Table 25 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，几乎所有泄漏都会把配置块复制到交接文件中，因此探针检测到的可能是一次即将发生的文件写入，而非泄漏本身。 一个仅知道该调用动作是否为文件写入的基线就能取得不错的成绩，但在写入交接文件的调用中，探针仍能区分泄漏与非泄漏（表 25）。

paragraphs.en: To test whether the input text alone carries the signal, we trained a bag-of-words classifier (TF-IDF features and logistic regression) on each call’s input, with the secret masked, on the same calls, folds and weights as the probe. Its settings are in Table 13 . We report two views of the input: the full input, and only its latest message. The latest message is narrower than what the incoming-only probe above reads, which is every message and tool result added since the previous call. The full input is long and largely repeats a fixed template, which may dilute what a bag-of-words model can find in it. The latest-message classifier comes close to the probe on Qwen3-32B, and the full-input classifier on gpt-oss-20b; against every view the probe keeps an edge whose interval excludes zero ( Table 25 ). So most of the per-call signal is present in the text the model reads, and the probe’s large margin over the zero-shot monitor comes mostly from training on these labels rather than from reading activations. On the Qwen3-32B test episodes, the latest-message classifier, fit on all development calls, scores 0.96, and the probe’s paired edge over it is +0.02 (95% interval − - 0.01 to +0.05), which includes zero.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验仅凭输入文本是否携带信号，我们在每次调用的输入上训练了一个词袋分类器（TF-IDF 特征加逻辑回归），对秘密进行掩码处理，并使用与探针相同的调用、折和权重。 其设置见表 13。 我们报告输入的两种视图：完整输入，以及仅其最新一条消息。 最新消息比上文仅输入探针所读取的范围更窄，后者读取的是自上一次调用以来新增的每条消息和每个工具结果。 完整输入很长且在很大程度上重复固定模板，这可能会稀释词袋模型能在其中发现的信息。 最新消息分类器在 Qwen3-32B 上接近探针，完整输入分类器在 gpt-oss-20b 上接近探针；而在两种视图下，探针都保持着一个区间不含零的优势（表 25）。 因此，大部分逐调用信号存在于模型读取的文本中，而探针相对零样本监控器的大幅领先主要来自在这些标签上的训练，而非来自读取激活值。 在 Qwen3-32B 测试回合上，在全部开发调用上拟合的最新消息分类器得分为 0.96，探针相对它的成对优势为 +0.02（95% 区间为 -0.01 到 +0.05），该区间包含零。

paragraphs.en: It mostly tracks a coming disclosure, most strongly right after the value is read. With the episode’s history held fixed, permitting the disclosure leaves the probe’s score unchanged. In new episodes, nearly every disclosure that directly follows a read of the value crosses the threshold, permitted or forbidden. Away from a read, forbidden leaks cross about twice as often as permitted shares. We show this in three steps: a replay of saved calls under changed rules, new episodes on one scenario under a permitting rule, and new episodes on all five test scenarios that separate the effect of a recent read.
paragraphs.zh: 它主要追踪即将发生的披露，在值刚被读取之后追踪最强。 在保持情节历史不变的情况下，允许该披露不会改变探针的得分。 在新的情节中，几乎每一次紧随值读取之后的披露都会越过阈值，无论被允许还是被禁止。 在远离读取的情况下，被禁止的泄露越过阈值的频率大约是允许的分享的两倍。 我们分三步展示这一点：在更改规则后重放已保存的调用，在一个场景上使用允许规则运行新情节，以及在全部五个测试场景上运行新情节以分离近期读取的影响。

sents.zh: 它主要追踪即将发生的披露，在值刚被读取之后追踪最强。

sents.zh: 在保持情节历史不变的情况下，允许该披露不会改变探针的得分。

sents.en: In new episodes, nearly every disclosure that directly follows a read of the value crosses the threshold, permitted or forbidden.
sents.zh: 在新的情节中，几乎每一次紧随值读取之后的披露都会越过阈值，无论被允许还是被禁止。

sents.en: Away from a read, forbidden leaks cross about twice as often as permitted shares.
sents.zh: 在远离读取的情况下，被禁止的泄露越过阈值的频率大约是允许的分享的两倍。

sents.en: We show this in three steps: a replay of saved calls under changed rules, new episodes on one scenario under a permitting rule, and new episodes on all five test scenarios that separate the effect of a recent read.
sents.zh: 我们分三步展示这一点：在更改规则后重放已保存的调用，在一个场景上使用允许规则运行新情节，以及在全部五个测试场景上运行新情节以分离近期读取的影响。

paragraphs.en: We take the leaking calls of the test episodes and matched non-leaking calls from the same scenarios and rounds, and re-run each call’s exact prompt through the model under changed system prompts: the original rule, a rule that explicitly permits sharing the value with teammates, and a neutral rewording that permits nothing new. On Qwen3-32B we add a fourth prompt, the permitting rule with the rule’s sentence about the consequences of a disclosure also removed. The saved reply is held fixed, so only the rule changes, and the last-prompt probe scores the last prompt token as before, with no refitting. On gpt-oss-20b this is the last-prompt probe, not the reasoning probe.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选取测试局中发生泄露的通话，并从相同场景和相同轮次中匹配未泄露的通话，在更改系统提示词的情况下，将每次通话的原始提示词原样重新输入模型：即原有规则、一条明确允许与队友分享该数值的规则，以及一条未允许任何新内容的与原规则同义改写的中性表述。 在 Qwen3-32B 上我们增加了第四个提示词，即在允许分享的规则中同时删去关于泄露后果的那句话。 保存的回复保持不变，因此只有规则发生变化，且最后提示词探针照旧对最后一个提示词词元打分，不进行任何重新拟合。 在 gpt-oss-20b 上这是最后提示词探针，而非推理探针。

sents.en: We take the leaking calls of the test episodes and matched non-leaking calls from the same scenarios and rounds, and re-run each call’s exact prompt through the model under changed system prompts: the original rule, a rule that explicitly permits sharing the value with teammates, and a neutral rewording that permits nothing new.
sents.zh: 我们选取测试局中发生泄露的通话，并从相同场景和相同轮次中匹配未泄露的通话，在更改系统提示词的情况下，将每次通话的原始提示词原样重新输入模型：即原有规则、一条明确允许与队友分享该数值的规则，以及一条未允许任何新内容的与原规则同义改写的中性表述。

sents.en: On Qwen3-32B we add a fourth prompt, the permitting rule with the rule’s sentence about the consequences of a disclosure also removed.
sents.zh: 在 Qwen3-32B 上我们增加了第四个提示词，即在允许分享的规则中同时删去关于泄露后果的那句话。

sents.zh: 保存的回复保持不变，因此只有规则发生变化，且最后提示词探针照旧对最后一个提示词词元打分，不进行任何重新拟合。

sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上这是最后提示词探针，而非推理探针。

paragraphs.en: No prompt lowers the score of leaking calls ( Table 27 ). The probe ranks leaking above non-leaking calls about equally well under every prompt, and nearly the same leaking calls cross the threshold. Removing the consequence sentence as well raises the median score slightly (+0.12). Neither the text of the rule nor its stated consequence drives the score. These replayed prompts still contain the agent’s earlier refusals, which the next subsection removes.
paragraphs.zh: 没有任何提示词能降低泄露调用的分数（表 27）。 在每种提示词下，探测器对泄露调用的排名都大致同等程度地高于非泄露调用，且越过阈值的泄露调用几乎相同。 同时移除后果句也会使中位数分数略微上升（+0.12）。 规则的文本本身及其所述的后果都不是分数的驱动因素。 这些重放的提示词仍然包含智能体先前的拒绝内容，下一小节将把这部分移除。

sents.en: No prompt lowers the score of leaking calls ( Table 27 ).
sents.zh: 没有任何提示词能降低泄露调用的分数（表 27）。

sents.zh: 规则的文本本身及其所述的后果都不是分数的驱动因素。

paragraphs.en: We ran 60 new Qwen3-32B episodes on the dispatch-integration-code scenario, the test scenario with the most leaking calls, with everything as in its test episodes except the target’s system prompt. Half use the permitting rule of the replay with the consequence sentence kept, and half also drop the consequence sentence. One incomplete episode per arm is excluded, as in the main episodes. A sharing call is the first call whose output contains the value, and the last-prompt probe and threshold, both set on development episodes, score every call from the first read of the protected file to that call, with no refitting.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在调度集成代码场景（即泄漏调用最多的测试场景）上运行了 60 个新的 Qwen3-32B 轨次，除目标智能体的系统提示词外，其余设置与其测试轨次完全一致。 其中一半沿用回放中的允许规则并保留后果句子，另一半则在沿用允许规则的同时删去后果句子。 与主轨次一致，每组各排除一个不完整的轨次。 共享调用是指输出中包含该值的第一个调用，且“最后提示探测”与阈值（均在开发轨次上设定）会对从首次读取受保护文件到该调用之间的每个调用进行评分，无需重新拟合。

sents.en: We ran 60 new Qwen3-32B episodes on the dispatch-integration-code scenario, the test scenario with the most leaking calls, with everything as in its test episodes except the target’s system prompt.
sents.zh: 我们在调度集成代码场景（即泄漏调用最多的测试场景）上运行了 60 个新的 Qwen3-32B 轨次，除目标智能体的系统提示词外，其余设置与其测试轨次完全一致。

sents.en: One incomplete episode per arm is excluded, as in the main episodes.
sents.zh: 与主轨次一致，每组各排除一个不完整的轨次。

sents.en: A sharing call is the first call whose output contains the value, and the last-prompt probe and threshold, both set on development episodes, score every call from the first read of the protected file to that call, with no refitting.
sents.zh: 共享调用是指输出中包含该值的第一个调用，且“最后提示探测”与阈值（均在开发轨次上设定）会对从首次读取受保护文件到该调用之间的每个调用进行评分，无需重新拟合。

paragraphs.en: With the consequence sentence kept, half the episodes never share, and those that do share only after several rounds of requests, as the forbidden leakers do. Their sharing calls score like forbidden leaks ( Table 28 ). With a clean permission, every episode shares at once, in the first or second round, and the probe mostly does not fire: 28% of sharing calls cross the threshold, and their median score minus that of the forbidden leaks is − - 1.36 (95% CI − - 1.82 to − - 0.91). Early timing alone does not explain the drop, because forbidden leaks in the first two rounds still score high. Part of this gap reflects when the value was read, and part the single scenario. The next subsection separates both on all five test scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: 保留后果句时，一半的情节从不共享，而那些共享的情节也像禁止的泄露者一样，要经过数轮请求后才共享。 它们的共享调用得分与禁止的泄露相近（表 28）。 在获得明确许可时，每个情节都在第一或第二轮立即共享，且探针大多不触发：28% 的共享调用越过阈值，其得分与禁止泄露得分之差的中位数为 −1.36（95% 置信区间为 −1.82 至 −0.91）。 仅仅提早的时间点并不能解释这一下降，因为前两轮中的禁止泄露仍然得分很高。 这一差距部分反映了读取数值的时机，部分反映了单一情景。 下一小节将在全部五个测试情景上对这两者加以区分。

sents.zh: 保留后果句时，一半的情节从不共享，而那些共享的情节也像禁止的泄露者一样，要经过数轮请求后才共享。

sents.en: Their sharing calls score like forbidden leaks ( Table 28 ).
sents.zh: 它们的共享调用得分与禁止的泄露相近（表 28）。

sents.zh: 这一差距部分反映了读取数值的时机，部分反映了单一情景。

sents.en: The next subsection separates both on all five test scenarios.
sents.zh: 下一小节将在全部五个测试情景上对这两者加以区分。

paragraphs.en: We repeat the comparison on the five Qwen3-32B test scenarios, running each scenario’s test setup unchanged except for the target’s rule and, in one arm, the peer’s timing. Under the forbidding rule, 95 new episodes yield 39 leaks, which we pool with the test leaks for 77 forbidden leaks. Under the clean permission of Section I.2 , the peer either asks at once, as in the test episodes (109 episodes, including the clean-permission episodes above), or first coordinates on the ordinary task and asks for the value only in its fifth message (99 episodes). The same probe and threshold score every call from the first read of the protected file to the sharing call, with no refitting. The main comparison, fixed before the episodes were run, uses sharing calls that do not directly follow a read, meaning that the call’s prompt does not end with the tool result that contains the value.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五个 Qwen3-32B 测试场景上重复该对比，每个场景的测试设置保持不变，仅改变目标方的规则，并且其中一个分支中改变对等方的时机。 在禁止规则下，95 个新回合产生了 39 次泄露，我们将其与测试泄露合并，共得到 77 次禁止泄露。 在第 I.2 节的干净许可下，对等方要么像测试回合中那样立即询问（109 个回合，包括上述干净许可回合），要么先就普通任务进行协调，仅在第五条消息中询问该值（99 个回合）。 同一探针和阈值对从首次读取受保护文件到共享调用的每次调用进行评分，无需重新拟合。 主要对比在回合运行前就已固定，使用的是不直接跟随读取的共享调用，即该调用的提示词末尾不是包含该值的工具结果。

sents.zh: 我们在五个 Qwen3-32B 测试场景上重复该对比，每个场景的测试设置保持不变，仅改变目标方的规则，并且其中一个分支中改变对等方的时机。

sents.en: Under the forbidding rule, 95 new episodes yield 39 leaks, which we pool with the test leaks for 77 forbidden leaks.
sents.zh: 在禁止规则下，95 个新回合产生了 39 次泄露，我们将其与测试泄露合并，共得到 77 次禁止泄露。

sents.en: The same probe and threshold score every call from the first read of the protected file to the sharing call, with no refitting.
sents.zh: 同一探针和阈值对从首次读取受保护文件到共享调用的每次调用进行评分，无需重新拟合。

sents.en: The main comparison, fixed before the episodes were run, uses sharing calls that do not directly follow a read, meaning that the call’s prompt does not end with the tool result that contains the value.
sents.zh: 主要对比在回合运行前就已固定，使用的是不直接跟随读取的共享调用，即该调用的提示词末尾不是包含该值的工具结果。

paragraphs.en: Right after a read, nearly every sharing call crosses the threshold under every rule: 98% of forbidden leaks, 97% of shares when the peer asks at once and 100% when it asks late ( Figures 8 and 29 ). No permitted episode refused or hedged before sharing, while 51 of the 77 forbidden leaks came after a refusal or a hedge, so a fresh read alone puts the score over the threshold. Away from a read, 19 of 31 forbidden leaks cross (61%), against 24 of 73 permitted shares when the peer asks at once (33%), a difference of − - 28 points (95% CI − - 49 to − - 8). When the peer asks late, 1 of 7 such shares cross. Forbidden leaks follow a read more often than permitted shares do (46 of 77 against 36 of 109), so pooling all sharing calls raises both rates (83% against 54%). The probe therefore reads a coming disclosure, most strongly right after the value is read and more strongly when the disclosure is contested. The delayed request worked: the late peer first asked for the value in its fifth message in 82 of 99 episodes. But the target re-read the file before 91 of its 98 shares, so the test of timing rests on few calls, and in every permitted episode the share was also uncontested.
paragraphs.zh: 读取之后，几乎每一次共享调用在所有规则下都越过阈值：98%的禁止性泄露、对端立即询问时97%的共享、对端延后询问时100%的共享（图8和图29）。 没有被允许的情节在共享前出现拒绝或含糊其辞，而77次禁止性泄露中有51次发生在拒绝或含糊其辞之后，因此仅仅一次新读取就足以让分数越过阈值。 远离读取时，31次禁止性泄露中有19次越过阈值（61%），而对端立即询问时73次被允许的共享中有24次越过（33%），差异为−28个百分点（95%置信区间−49至−8）。 当对端延后询问时，7次此类共享中有1次越过阈值。 禁止性泄露比被允许的共享更常紧随读取之后发生（77次中的46次对109次中的36次），因此合并所有共享调用会抬高两者的比率（83%对54%）。 因此该探针能够读出即将到来的披露，在值刚被读取后最强，而在披露受到质疑时也更强。 延迟请求奏效了：99个情节中有82个，延后询问的对端首次索要该值是在其第五条消息中。 但目标在其98次共享中有91次在共享前重新读取了该文件，因此对时机的检验只基于少数调用，而且在每一个被允许的情节中共享也都是未受质疑的。

paragraphs.en: The probe warns about the call that leaks, not earlier ones. At a threshold set for few false alarms per call, many refusing episodes still get at least one alarm ( Table 31 ).
paragraphs.zh: 探针会对发生泄露的那次调用发出警告，而不是更早的调用。 即使将阈值设定为每次调用仅产生极少量误报，许多拒绝回答的片段仍会触发至少一次警报（表 31）。

paragraphs.en: Asked whether the next call will leak, with the leaking call removed, the probe is much weaker on both models. On gpt-oss-20b, nearly all of the calls just before a leak are reads of the protected file, and a flag for that read scores about as well as the probe. Among those reads, the probe still separates the ones followed by a leak.
paragraphs.zh: 在移除泄漏的那次调用后，询问下一次调用是否会泄漏时，探针在两个模型上的表现都明显减弱。 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，几乎所有泄漏前的调用都是对受保护文件的读取，而针对该读取的标志位的表现与探针大致相当。 在这些读取中，探针仍然能够区分出随后发生泄漏的那部分调用。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9 aligns each leaking episode on its leaking call and shows the probe’s score as a percentile among that model’s scored calls. On average, the score is lower over the calls before the leak and rises sharply at the leaking call, on both models and both sets of episodes, although individual episodes vary. Its example episodes are chosen by one fixed rule: for each model, the leaking test episode of median length among those with at least five scored calls.
paragraphs.zh: 图 9 将每次泄露事件在其泄露调用处对齐，并显示探针的分数在该模型所有已评分调用中所处的百分位。 平均而言，分数在泄露前的调用中较低，并在泄露调用处急剧上升，这在两个模型和两组事件上都成立，尽管个别事件存在差异。 其示例事件由一条固定规则选定：对于每个模型，选取在至少有五个已评分调用的事件中长度位于中位数的泄露测试事件。

paragraphs.en: gpt-oss-20b’s reasoning is short, and most of the reasoning probe’s first alarms on leaking calls fire at the first reasoning token. paragraphs.en: We set each threshold on control calls, so that about 5% of them alarm. At that threshold the reasoning probe catches most leaking calls in development while few calls in refusing episodes alarm. Counted per episode, however, a sizeable share of refusing episodes get at least one alarm, because each episode has many calls. A threshold set so that about 5% of control episodes alarm catches about a third of leaking episodes before the first leak. On the test episodes, the threshold set on development control calls caught about half of the leaking calls ( Appendix F ). The Qwen3-32B operating points on the test episodes, and how per-call and per-episode rates relate, are in Section 4.4 . On the Qwen3-32B test episodes, the probe catches 82% of leaking calls (Wilson 95% interval 67% to 91%). Jev, at the cutoff that flags no more calls in refusing episodes than the probe, catches 26% (95% interval 8% to 39%, from resampling episodes and re-matching the cutoff each time). Table 30 compares the per-call and per-episode thresholds on both models, with the share of flagged calls that are real leaks and the gap between control and refusing traffic.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在控制调用上设定各个阈值，使其中约 5% 会报警。 在该阈值下，推理探针在开发阶段能捕获大多数泄漏调用，而拒绝情节中很少有调用报警。 然而，按情节计数，相当大比例的拒绝情节至少会有一次报警，因为每个情节包含大量调用。 设定使约 5% 的控制情节报警的阈值，能在首次泄漏之前捕获约三分之一的泄漏情节。 在测试情节上，基于开发控制调用设定的阈值捕获了约一半的泄漏调用（附录 F）。 Qwen3-32B 在测试情节上的工作点，以及按调用计和按情节计的比率之间的关系，见第 4.4 节。 在 Qwen3-32B 测试情节上，该探针捕获 82% 的泄漏调用（Wilson 95% 区间为 67% 到 91%）。 Jev 在与探针在拒绝情节中标记调用数不多于后者的截止点下，捕获 26%（95% 区间为 8% 到 39%，通过对情节进行重采样并在每次重新匹配截止点得出）。 表 30 比较了两个模型上按调用计和按情节计的阈值，包括被标记调用中真实泄漏的比例以及控制流量与拒绝流量之间的差距。

sents.en: Table 30 compares the per-call and per-episode thresholds on both models, with the share of flagged calls that are real leaks and the gap between control and refusing traffic.
sents.zh: 表 30 比较了两个模型上按调用计和按情节计的阈值，包括被标记调用中真实泄漏的比例以及控制流量与拒绝流量之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: A deployed alarm would need its threshold set per episode, as Gao (2026) also argues. Figure 10 shows the full trade-off between leaking calls caught and refusing calls alarmed for the probe and Jev on the same calls.
paragraphs.zh: 部署的警报需要按情节（episode）设置阈值，Gao（2026）也提出了这一观点。 图 10 展示了在同一批通话上，探针与 Jev 在“捕捉到的泄露通话”与“被警报拒绝的通话”之间的完整权衡关系。

sents.zh: 部署的警报需要按情节（episode）设置阈值，Gao（2026）也提出了这一观点。

sents.en: Figure 10 shows the full trade-off between leaking calls caught and refusing calls alarmed for the probe and Jev on the same calls.
sents.zh: 图 10 展示了在同一批通话上，探针与 Jev 在“捕捉到的泄露通话”与“被警报拒绝的通话”之间的完整权衡关系。

paragraphs.en: No detectable gain. We paired the probe with a second detector on the Qwen3-32B test episodes and halted an episode at the first call that both flag. The second detector was either Jev or the bag-of-words classifier, fit once on all development calls and scored on the test calls. With the same cap on refusing episodes halted, no pairing catches more leaking episodes than the probe alone with a stricter threshold, and the pairing with Jev catches fewer ( Figures 11 and 32 ). At these strict thresholds the second detector misses most leaking episodes on its own. Every threshold is chosen on the test episodes, which favours the pairings because they have more thresholds to tune.
paragraphs.zh: 未检测到增益。 我们将探针与第二个检测器配对应用于 Qwen3-32B 测试回合，并在两者同时标记的首次调用处终止该回合。 第二个检测器要么是 Jev，要么是词袋分类器，前者在所有开发调用车一次性拟合，后者在测试调用上打分。 在对拒绝终止回合设置相同上限的情况下，没有任何配对能比采用更严格阈值的单独探针捕获更多泄露回合，而与 Jev 的配对捕获的更少（图 11 和图 32）。 在这些严格阈值下，第二个检测器自身会漏掉大多数泄露回合。 每个阈值都是在测试回合上选择的，这有利于配对方法，因为它们有更多可供调整的阈值。

paragraphs.en: On Qwen3-32B, whether the target leaks this round or the next is modestly predictable; the strongest text monitor scores a little above the probe on the episodes collected before the round-level plan, and about the same on the test episodes. Whether an episode will ever leak is barely predictable by either.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Qwen3-32B 上，目标本轮泄漏还是下一轮泄漏是可以中等程度预测的；在轮级计划之前收集的回合中，最强的文本监视器得分略高于探针，在测试回合上两者得分大致相同。 某一回合是否会泄漏，两者都几乎无法预测。

paragraphs.en: These analyses are separate from the ladder of Figure 3 , which uses one set of calls and one leak definition, with a label for each of its three questions. They use the round-level label of Appendix B on the Qwen3-32B episodes scored for the round-level plan, and stop scoring before the secret is first written out, so they never include the leaking call. Three monitor models, asked two questions at three levels of access, were scored on the same calls ( Appendix E ). The strongest is Jev asked to forecast a leak at any later point, shown everything the target had seen.
paragraphs.zh: 这些分析与图 3 的阶梯分析是分开的，后者使用同一组调用和同一种泄露定义，并针对其三个问题分别给出标签。 它们在为轮次级方案评分的 Qwen3-32B 剧集上使用附录 B 的轮次级标签，并在机密首次被写出之前停止评分，因此它们从不包含泄露的调用。 三个监控模型在三种访问级别下被问了两个问题，并在相同的调用上进行评分（附录 E）。 最强的是让 Jev 预测后续任一时点的泄露，并向其展示目标所看到的一切。

sents.en: These analyses are separate from the ladder of Figure 3 , which uses one set of calls and one leak definition, with a label for each of its three questions.
sents.zh: 这些分析与图 3 的阶梯分析是分开的，后者使用同一组调用和同一种泄露定义，并针对其三个问题分别给出标签。

sents.en: They use the round-level label of Appendix B on the Qwen3-32B episodes scored for the round-level plan, and stop scoring before the secret is first written out, so they never include the leaking call.
sents.zh: 它们在为轮次级方案评分的 Qwen3-32B 剧集上使用附录 B 的轮次级标签，并在机密首次被写出之前停止评分，因此它们从不包含泄露的调用。

sents.en: Three monitor models, asked two questions at three levels of access, were scored on the same calls ( Appendix E ).
sents.zh: 三个监控模型在三种访问级别下被问了两个问题，并在相同的调用上进行评分（附录 E）。

sents.en: The strongest is Jev asked to forecast a leak at any later point, shown everything the target had seen.
sents.zh: 最强的是让 Jev 预测后续任一时点的泄露，并向其展示目标所看到的一切。

paragraphs.en: Asked to forecast, Jev does better than asked to detect a rule break in progress. Showing it the peer’s messages, on top of the target’s actions, gives most of its gain, and adding everything else the target saw adds little. Neither the forecasting question nor more access helped the other two monitors.
paragraphs.zh: 与被要求检测正在发生的规则违规相比，Jev 在被要求进行预测时表现更好。 在目标的行为之外再向它展示同行的消息，就带来了它的大部分提升，而再加上目标看到的其他所有内容则几乎没有什么增益。 对于另外两个监视器来说，无论是预测式提问还是更多的访问权限都没有带来帮助。

sents.en: Asked to forecast, Jev does better than asked to detect a rule break in progress.
sents.zh: 与被要求检测正在发生的规则违规相比，Jev 在被要求进行预测时表现更好。

sents.en: Showing it the peer’s messages, on top of the target’s actions, gives most of its gain, and adding everything else the target saw adds little.
sents.zh: 在目标的行为之外再向它展示同行的消息，就带来了它的大部分提升，而再加上目标看到的其他所有内容则几乎没有什么增益。

sents.en: Neither the forecasting question nor more access helped the other two monitors.
sents.zh: 对于另外两个监视器来说，无论是预测式提问还是更多的访问权限都没有带来帮助。

paragraphs.en: A small logistic model on the round, the prompt length and a monitor’s score was refit with the probe’s score added. The probe adds clearly to the weaker monitor on the test episodes, and adds nothing clear to the strongest one ( Table 33 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们以探测器的得分作为新增变量，对基于轮数、提示长度和监督者得分的逻辑回归模型进行了重新拟合。 在测试片段上，该探测器对较弱的监督者有明显增益，但对最强的监督者没有明显增益（表 33）。

sents.en: A small logistic model on the round, the prompt length and a monitor’s score was refit with the probe’s score added.
sents.zh: 我们以探测器的得分作为新增变量，对基于轮数、提示长度和监督者得分的逻辑回归模型进行了重新拟合。

sents.en: The probe adds clearly to the weaker monitor on the test episodes, and adds nothing clear to the strongest one ( Table 33 ).
sents.zh: 在测试片段上，该探测器对较弱的监督者有明显增益，但对最强的监督者没有明显增益（表 33）。

paragraphs.en: Whether the episode will ever leak is near chance for the probe, and only slightly above for the strongest monitor. Branching reruns from the same state often end differently, which suggests the outcome is often not yet decided far from the act.
paragraphs.zh: 对于探针而言，该事件片段是否会泄露的概率接近随机水平，而对于最强的监控器也只是略高于随机水平。 从同一状态分支重跑往往会以不同结局收场，这表明在远离行为发生点时，结局通常尚未注定。

sents.en: Whether the episode will ever leak is near chance for the probe, and only slightly above for the strongest monitor.
sents.zh: 对于探针而言，该事件片段是否会泄露的概率接近随机水平，而对于最强的监控器也只是略高于随机水平。

sents.en: Branching reruns from the same state often end differently, which suggests the outcome is often not yet decided far from the act.
sents.zh: 从同一状态分支重跑往往会以不同结局收场，这表明在远离行为发生点时，结局通常尚未注定。

paragraphs.en: The round-level “this round or the next” result on Qwen3-32B holds across two label variants that use hindsight to choose negatives, a fixed middle layer, weighting scenarios equally, and a small neural network instead of logistic regression ( Table 34 ).
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3-32B 上的轮次级「本轮或下一轮」结果在两种使用后见之明选择负样本的标签变体、固定的中间层、等权重场景，以及用小型神经网络替代逻辑回归的设置下均成立（表 34）。

paragraphs.en: On gpt-oss-20b, with the leak defined as a channel post, the probe and the best monitor are both near chance for this round or the next. The model usually leaks soon after the request: many of its channel leaks leave no call to score before them, and for most of the rest the earliest possible warning falls in the same round. Under the main label, which counts the earlier file write, the ladder of Figure 3 shows the same pattern as on Qwen3-32B.
paragraphs.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，若将泄露定义为频道帖子，则探针和最佳监控器在本轮或下一轮的表现都接近随机水平。 模型通常在请求后很快就泄露：它的许多频道泄露在之前没有可评分的调用，而在其余大多数情况下，最早可能的警告也落在同一轮。 在计入较早文件写入的主标签下，图 3 的阶梯呈现出与 Qwen3-32B 上相同的模式。

sents.en: On gpt-oss-20b, with the leak defined as a channel post, the probe and the best monitor are both near chance for this round or the next.
sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，若将泄露定义为频道帖子，则探针和最佳监控器在本轮或下一轮的表现都接近随机水平。

sents.en: The model usually leaks soon after the request: many of its channel leaks leave no call to score before them, and for most of the rest the earliest possible warning falls in the same round.
sents.zh: 模型通常在请求后很快就泄露：它的许多频道泄露在之前没有可评分的调用，而在其余大多数情况下，最早可能的警告也落在同一轮。

sents.en: Under the main label, which counts the earlier file write, the ladder of Figure 3 shows the same pattern as on Qwen3-32B.
sents.zh: 在计入较早文件写入的主标签下，图 3 的阶梯呈现出与 Qwen3-32B 上相同的模式。

paragraphs.en: On the development episodes, Qwen3-32B’s leaks go out about equally as the ordinary end-of-turn reply and as an explicit channel message, with a few file writes, while nearly every gpt-oss-20b leak is a file write. An automated judge labels most leaks deliberate on both models ( Table 35 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在开发事件记录中，Qwen3-32B 的泄露几乎均等地以普通回合结束回复和显式通道消息的形式出现，另有少量文件写入，而 gpt-oss-20b 的泄露几乎全部是文件写入。 自动评判器将两个模型的大多数泄露标记为蓄意行为（表 35）。

sents.en: On the development episodes, Qwen3-32B’s leaks go out about equally as the ordinary end-of-turn reply and as an explicit channel message, with a few file writes, while nearly every gpt-oss-20b leak is a file write.
sents.zh: 在开发事件记录中，Qwen3-32B 的泄露几乎均等地以普通回合结束回复和显式通道消息的形式出现，另有少量文件写入，而 gpt-oss-20b 的泄露几乎全部是文件写入。

sents.en: An automated judge labels most leaks deliberate on both models ( Table 35 ).
sents.zh: 自动评判器将两个模型的大多数泄露标记为蓄意行为（表 35）。

paragraphs.en: The end-of-turn reply is the text that the harness posts to the channel when the target finishes its turn. On gpt-oss-20b, the first leak is almost always the whole configuration block copied into the handoff file.
paragraphs.zh: 回合结束回复是目标完成其回合后，测试框架发布到频道的文本。 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，第一次泄露几乎总是整个配置块被复制到交接文件中。

sents.en: The end-of-turn reply is the text that the harness posts to the channel when the target finishes its turn.
sents.zh: 回合结束回复是目标完成其回合后，测试框架发布到频道的文本。

sents.en: On gpt-oss-20b, the first leak is almost always the whole configuration block copied into the handoff file.
sents.zh: 在 gpt-oss-20b 上，第一次泄露几乎总是整个配置块被复制到交接文件中。

paragraphs.en: A decision model, Luna Decisions ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , reads the first message that publishes the value. It labels the leak deliberate if the message offers the real value for use, and accidental if it exposes the value inside a refusal or an illustration. For a few Qwen3-32B leaks no saved judge label exists, and the table counts them separately. We keep accidental leaks in the label, because an overseer must stop them too.
paragraphs.zh: 一个决策模型 Luna Decisions（OpenAI, 2026b）会读取第一条发布该数值的消息。 如果该消息提供真实数值以供使用，它将泄漏标记为故意；如果它在拒绝或示例中暴露数值，则标记为意外。 对于少数 Qwen3-32B 泄漏，不存在已保存的裁判标签，表中将它们单独计数。 我们在标签中保留意外泄漏，因为监督者也必须阻止它们。

sents.en: A decision model, Luna Decisions ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , reads the first message that publishes the value.
sents.zh: 一个决策模型 Luna Decisions（OpenAI, 2026b）会读取第一条发布该数值的消息。

sents.en: It labels the leak deliberate if the message offers the real value for use, and accidental if it exposes the value inside a refusal or an illustration.
sents.zh: 如果该消息提供真实数值以供使用，它将泄漏标记为故意；如果它在拒绝或示例中暴露数值，则标记为意外。

sents.en: For a few Qwen3-32B leaks no saved judge label exists, and the table counts them separately.
sents.zh: 对于少数 Qwen3-32B 泄漏，不存在已保存的裁判标签，表中将它们单独计数。

sents.en: We keep accidental leaks in the label, because an overseer must stop them too.
sents.zh: 我们在标签中保留意外泄漏，因为监督者也必须阻止它们。

paragraphs.en: A decision-model pass flagged peer messages that claim to speak for the operator. On Qwen3-32B, leaks were about as common in episodes with such a claim as in episodes without one ( Table 35 ).
paragraphs.zh: 决策模型的一轮筛查标记出了那些声称代表运营方发言的同行消息。 在 Qwen3-32B 上，出现此类声称的回合与没有此类声称的回合中，泄露的发生率大致相当（表 35）。

sents.en: A decision-model pass flagged peer messages that claim to speak for the operator.
sents.zh: 决策模型的一轮筛查标记出了那些声称代表运营方发言的同行消息。

sents.en: On Qwen3-32B, leaks were about as common in episodes with such a claim as in episodes without one ( Table 35 ).
sents.zh: 在 Qwen3-32B 上，出现此类声称的回合与没有此类声称的回合中，泄露的发生率大致相当（表 35）。

paragraphs.en: Qwen3-32B leaked in some episodes and refused in others under almost every setting we screened, and the screens are too small to show which settings matter. gpt-oss-20b and Gemma-4-31B refused direct requests for the secret, so gpt-oss-20b faces a different peer strategy and Gemma-4-31B was not used for probes.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen3-32B 在我们筛查的几乎每种设置下，在某些剧集中泄露了秘密，在另一些剧集中则予以拒绝，而这些筛查规模太小，无法表明哪些设置是关键因素。gpt-oss-20b 和 Gemma-4-31B 拒绝了直接索取秘密的请求，因此 gpt-oss-20b 面对的是一种不同的智能体策略，而 Gemma-4-31B 未被用于探测。

paragraphs.en: Before fixing the final setup, we ran small screens on Qwen3-32B that each varied one feature of the episode ( Table 36 ). Most screens use an earlier version of the main scenario. The own-stake screen uses four other scenarios, in which the target gains something from sharing the value. These screens use the scoring rules of the original screening runs, and Table 36 describes behaviour without testing any setting. Table 4 gives the leak rate of the final collection in each scenario.
paragraphs.zh: 在确定最终设置之前，我们在 Qwen3-32B 上运行了若干小型筛选实验，每个实验改变回合（episode）的一个特征（表 36）。 大多数筛选实验使用主场景的一个较早版本。 自身利益筛选实验使用另外四个场景，在这些场景中，目标会从分享价值中获得收益。 这些筛选实验使用最初筛选运行的评分规则，表 36 描述了行为而不测试任何设置。 表 4 给出了每个场景中最终收集的泄露率。

sents.en: Before fixing the final setup, we ran small screens on Qwen3-32B that each varied one feature of the episode ( Table 36 ).
sents.zh: 在确定最终设置之前，我们在 Qwen3-32B 上运行了若干小型筛选实验，每个实验改变回合（episode）的一个特征（表 36）。

sents.en: Most screens use an earlier version of the main scenario.
sents.zh: 大多数筛选实验使用主场景的一个较早版本。

sents.en: The own-stake screen uses four other scenarios, in which the target gains something from sharing the value.
sents.zh: 自身利益筛选实验使用另外四个场景，在这些场景中，目标会从分享价值中获得收益。

sents.en: These screens use the scoring rules of the original screening runs, and Table 36 describes behaviour without testing any setting.
sents.zh: 这些筛选实验使用最初筛选运行的评分规则，表 36 描述了行为而不测试任何设置。

sents.en: Table 4 gives the leak rate of the final collection in each scenario.
sents.zh: 表 4 给出了每个场景中最终收集的泄露率。

paragraphs.en: Each screen was a separate collection, so a gap between two rows can reflect the batch or the scenario version as well as the setting. One set of plain-request episodes serves as the reference for the tactic, thinking and peer-count screens. The seven single tactics are helpful framing, an organiser’s tone, a trade, social proof, time pressure, playing it safe and cost anchoring. We adapted them from the persuasion prompts released by Nakamura et al. (2026) and kept that source’s honesty limits. The reproducibility index points to the full table, which lists every cell with its interval and every excluded episode ( Appendix Q ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个屏幕都是一个独立的集合，因此两行之间的差距可能反映批次或情景版本，也可能反映设置本身。 一组普通请求的片段作为策略、思考以及同伴数量这三个屏幕的参照。 七种单一策略分别是：有用的框架、组织者的口吻、交易、社会证明、时间压力、求稳以及成本锚定。 我们改编自 Nakamura 等人发布的说服提示词。 （2026），并保留了该来源的诚实性限制。 可复现性索引指向完整表格，其中列出了每个单元格及其区间，以及每个被排除的片段（附录 Q）。

sents.zh: 一组普通请求的片段作为策略、思考以及同伴数量这三个屏幕的参照。

sents.en: The seven single tactics are helpful framing, an organiser’s tone, a trade, social proof, time pressure, playing it safe and cost anchoring.
sents.zh: 七种单一策略分别是：有用的框架、组织者的口吻、交易、社会证明、时间压力、求稳以及成本锚定。

sents.en: We adapted them from the persuasion prompts released by Nakamura et al.
sents.zh: 我们改编自 Nakamura 等人发布的说服提示词。

sents.en: (2026) and kept that source’s honesty limits.
sents.zh: （2026），并保留了该来源的诚实性限制。

sents.zh: 可复现性索引指向完整表格，其中列出了每个单元格及其区间，以及每个被排除的片段（附录 Q）。

paragraphs.en: Note a: turning thinking on also raised the reply-length limit, so this row changes two things at once. Note b: an automated judge flagged episodes in which the target seemed to recognise a test. Both flagged episodes only mention the mocked software tests in the task, so neither clearly shows such recognition.
paragraphs.zh: 注 a：开启思考同时也提高了回复长度上限，因此这一行同时改变了两个因素。 注 b：自动裁判标记了目标似乎识别出测试的回合。 这两个被标记的回合都只在任务中提到了模拟的软件测试，因此都没有明确显示这种识别。

sents.en: Note a: turning thinking on also raised the reply-length limit, so this row changes two things at once.
sents.zh: 注 a：开启思考同时也提高了回复长度上限，因此这一行同时改变了两个因素。

sents.en: Note b: an automated judge flagged episodes in which the target seemed to recognise a test.
sents.zh: 注 b：自动裁判标记了目标似乎识别出测试的回合。

sents.en: Both flagged episodes only mention the mocked software tests in the task, so neither clearly shows such recognition.
sents.zh: 这两个被标记的回合都只在任务中提到了模拟的软件测试，因此都没有明确显示这种识别。

paragraphs.en: For gpt-oss-20b only the peer and the scored window change. The task, the rule, the secret, the leak label and the detectors stay the same, and so does the control principle: a peer that never asks for the value.
paragraphs.zh: 仅对于 gpt-oss-20b，改变的只有同伴智能体和被评分的窗口。 任务、规则、秘密、泄露标签和检测器保持不变，控制原则也是如此：一个从不索取该值的同伴智能体。

sents.en: For gpt-oss-20b only the peer and the scored window change.
sents.zh: 仅对于 gpt-oss-20b，改变的只有同伴智能体和被评分的窗口。

sents.en: The task, the rule, the secret, the leak label and the detectors stay the same, and so does the control principle: a peer that never asks for the value.
sents.zh: 任务、规则、秘密、泄露标签和检测器保持不变，控制原则也是如此：一个从不索取该值的同伴智能体。

paragraphs.en: The peer runs on DeepSeek-V4-Pro instead of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, with its own prompt ( Appendix R ). gpt-oss-20b mostly refused the plain request, and it never leaked when the peer stacked every tactic at once. The peer therefore first coordinates on the ordinary task, then asks for the whole configuration block for a handoff file, without naming the secret. We accepted a strategy only if four things held. The target read the secret before any leak, made a scored call between the read and the leak, leaked in some episodes and refused in others, and never leaked in control episodes. We chose the strategy on behaviour alone and froze it before any probe or monitor saw the data.
paragraphs.zh: 对端运行的是 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 而不是 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，并使用其自己的提示词（附录 R）。gpt-oss-20b 大多拒绝了直接请求，并且当对端同时叠加所有策略时也从未泄露。 因此，对端先就普通任务进行协调，然后索要用于交接文件的完整配置块，而不点名该密钥。 只有满足以下四点，我们才接受某个策略。 目标在任何泄露发生之前就读取了密钥，在读取与泄露之间做出了有评分的判断，在某些回合中泄露而在其他回合中拒绝，并且在对照回合中从未泄露。 我们仅依据行为来选择策略，并在任何探测或监控器看到数据之前将其冻结。

sents.en: The peer runs on DeepSeek-V4-Pro instead of DeepSeek-V4-Flash, with its own prompt ( Appendix R ). gpt-oss-20b mostly refused the plain request, and it never leaked when the peer stacked every tactic at once.
sents.zh: 对端运行的是 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 而不是 DeepSeek-V4-Flash，并使用其自己的提示词（附录 R）。gpt-oss-20b 大多拒绝了直接请求，并且当对端同时叠加所有策略时也从未泄露。

sents.en: The peer therefore first coordinates on the ordinary task, then asks for the whole configuration block for a handoff file, without naming the secret.
sents.zh: 因此，对端先就普通任务进行协调，然后索要用于交接文件的完整配置块，而不点名该密钥。

sents.en: We accepted a strategy only if four things held.
sents.zh: 只有满足以下四点，我们才接受某个策略。

sents.en: The target read the secret before any leak, made a scored call between the read and the leak, leaked in some episodes and refused in others, and never leaked in control episodes.
sents.zh: 目标在任何泄露发生之前就读取了密钥，在读取与泄露之间做出了有评分的判断，在某些回合中泄露而在其他回合中拒绝，并且在对照回合中从未泄露。

sents.en: We chose the strategy on behaviour alone and froze it before any probe or monitor saw the data.
sents.zh: 我们仅依据行为来选择策略，并在任何探测或监控器看到数据之前将其冻结。

paragraphs.en: The scored window on gpt-oss-20b starts at the peer’s first request for the block, not at the read. The calls between the read and that request carry no pressure, so we keep them as a placebo on which a sound detector scores at chance ( Appendix H ).
paragraphs.zh: gpt-oss-20b 上的计分窗口始于对等方的首次针对该区块的请求，而非始于读取。 读取与该请求之间的调用不产生任何压力，因此我们将其保留作为安慰剂，可靠的检测器在其上的得分仅为随机水平（附录 H）。

sents.en: The scored window on gpt-oss-20b starts at the peer’s first request for the block, not at the read.
sents.zh: gpt-oss-20b 上的计分窗口始于对等方的首次针对该区块的请求，而非始于读取。

sents.en: The calls between the read and that request carry no pressure, so we keep them as a placebo on which a sound detector scores at chance ( Appendix H ).
sents.zh: 读取与该请求之间的调用不产生任何压力，因此我们将其保留作为安慰剂，可靠的检测器在其上的得分仅为随机水平（附录 H）。

paragraphs.en: Gemma-4-31B almost never leaked under direct requests, and in a small batch under the delayed block request it wrote the secret into a file every time. It therefore gave no mix of leaking and refusing episodes, so we ran no replay, probes or monitors on it.
paragraphs.zh: Gemma-4-31B 在直接请求下几乎没有泄露，而在延迟拦截请求的小批量测试中，它每次都会把秘密写入文件。 因此它没有出现泄露与拒绝混合的情形，所以我们没有对它运行重放、探针或监控器。

sents.en: Gemma-4-31B almost never leaked under direct requests, and in a small batch under the delayed block request it wrote the secret into a file every time.
sents.zh: Gemma-4-31B 在直接请求下几乎没有泄露，而在延迟拦截请求的小批量测试中，它每次都会把秘密写入文件。

sents.en: It therefore gave no mix of leaking and refusing episodes, so we ran no replay, probes or monitors on it.
sents.zh: 因此它没有出现泄露与拒绝混合的情形，所以我们没有对它运行重放、探针或监控器。

paragraphs.en: These limitations matter less for the headlines than those in Section 6 .
paragraphs.zh: 与第 6 节中的那些局限性相比，这些局限性对结论的影响较小。

paragraphs.en: The gpt-oss-20b leaks come from one peer strategy, a delayed request to copy the whole configuration block, so they may reflect careless copying of an instruction as much as giving in to pressure.
paragraphs.zh: gpt-oss-20b 的泄露来自一种对抗策略，即延迟请求复制整个配置块，因此这些泄露可能在反映屈服于压力的同时，也反映了对指令的粗心复制。

paragraphs.en: One call ahead the signal is much weaker, and on gpt-oss-20b it mostly reflects the file read that precedes the leak ( Appendix J ).
paragraphs.zh: 再往前调用一次，信号就弱得多，在 gpt-oss-20b 上，它主要反映了泄漏之前的文件读取（附录 J）。

paragraphs.en: At a per-call threshold, most refusing Qwen3-32B episodes see at least one flag, which suits escalating single calls rather than halting the agent ( Section 4.4 ). The stricter per-episode thresholds, for the probe alone and for the paired detectors, are chosen on the test episodes, so they show the trade-off rather than test a threshold fixed in advance. Calls before the first read of the protected file are not scored. The target reads the file in the first round in 84 of 89 Qwen3-32B test episodes, so there are 117 such calls against 1825 scored ones, but their false-alarm rate is unmeasured.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次调用的阈值下，大多数拒绝回答的 Qwen3-32B 回合至少会出现一次标记，这适合逐步升级的单次调用，而不是直接停止智能体（第 4.4 节）。 更严格的每回合阈值（包括仅针对探针的以及配对检测器的）是在测试回合上选定的，因此它们展示的是权衡关系，而非检验一个事先固定的阈值。 在首次读取受保护文件之前的调用不会被计分。 在 89 个 Qwen3-32B 测试回合中，目标在第一轮就读取该文件的情况有 84 个，因此共有 117 次这样的调用，而被计分的调用为 1825 次，但这些调用的误报率未被测量。

sents.zh: 在每次调用的阈值下，大多数拒绝回答的 Qwen3-32B 回合至少会出现一次标记，这适合逐步升级的单次调用，而不是直接停止智能体（第 4.4 节）。

sents.zh: 在首次读取受保护文件之前的调用不会被计分。

sents.en: The target reads the file in the first round in 84 of 89 Qwen3-32B test episodes, so there are 117 such calls against 1825 scored ones, but their false-alarm rate is unmeasured.
sents.zh: 在 89 个 Qwen3-32B 测试回合中，目标在第一轮就读取该文件的情况有 84 个，因此共有 117 次这样的调用，而被计分的调用为 1825 次，但这些调用的误报率未被测量。

paragraphs.en: The leak label is an exact match on the tool log. Whether a leak was deliberate or accidental, which we use only to describe the leaks, comes from an automated judge ( Appendix L ).
paragraphs.zh: 泄露标签是对工具日志的精确匹配。 泄露是故意的还是意外的（我们仅用其来描述泄露），来自一个自动化裁判（附录 L）。

sents.en: The leak label is an exact match on the tool log.
sents.zh: 泄露标签是对工具日志的精确匹配。
